faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about MyHigh5
faq.question_1: How can I earn money on MyHigh5?
faq.answer_1: You can earn through contest prizes, affiliate commissions from referrals, and Founding Member pools.
faq.question_2: How does the affiliate program work?
faq.answer_2: You earn 10% on direct referrals (level 1) and 1% on levels 2-10 for eligible products and activities.
faq.answer_3: Founding Member is a limited membership with extra revenue and profit-sharing benefits.
faq.answer_4: Create a free account, complete your profile, and submit your content based on contest requirements.
faq.answer_5: Yes. Most contests are free, though some verification steps may have a fee.
faq.answer_6: Use your wallet in the dashboard and follow available withdrawal options.
faq.question_7: How do you determine the quality of winners in categories such as football and boxing without involving professional judges?
faq.answer_7:
Our contests are not intended to be professionally judged, because professionalism is only one part of the overall factors that influence a contestant's appeal. A participant may not win by professional standards, yet still be preferred by the audience due to the entertainment they provide during the contest or through other content, such as their interaction with fans.

In today's highly connected social media environment, professionally judged performance is only one element of what resonates with an audience. MyHigh5 is designed as a user-driven voting platform, where audience engagement, including voting, sharing, liking, commenting, and viewing, determines the winners.
